newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB leaves interest rates steady at weekly meeting.
newsitem.headline: SNB leaves interest rates steady at weekly meeting.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank left its interest rates unchanged at a weekly meeting of its three-member council, an SNB spokesman said in response to an enquiry on Wednesday.
The meeting was held Wednesday instead of on Thursday.
The spokesman said there was nothing unusual in the fact the meeting was held a day earlier in the week than normal, adding this is sometimes done for organisational reasons.

The discount rate remains steady at 1.00 percent, the level set when it was lowered from 1.50 percent on September 26, 1996. At current levels the rate matches the all-time low maintained from February 1978 to November 1979.
